package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/robfig/cron/v3"
)

// scenario for background_jobs_registered_from_gin_packages_instead_of_bootstrap: Scheduler or worker registration hidden inside Gin transport packages.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

var cronScheduler *cron.Cron

func init() {
	cronScheduler = cron.New()

	cronScheduler.AddFunc("@every 1h", func() {
		fmt.Println("running hourly report generation")
	})

	cronScheduler.AddFunc("@daily", func() {
		fmt.Println("running daily data cleanup")
	})

	cronScheduler.Start()
}

func reportHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	cronScheduler.AddFunc("@every 30m", func() {
		fmt.Println("running ad-hoc analytics from handler")
	})
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	fmt.Fprintln(w, "report triggered")
}
